description: This file defines the RewriteRulesManager class, which manages URL rewrite rules including creation, validation, deletion, updating, and ordering within the OrchardCore URL Rewriting module.

classes.name: RewriteRulesManager
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IRewriteRulesManager, responsible for managing URL rewrite rules including CRUD operations, validation, and order management.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a rewrite rule, invoking handler events before and after deletion.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates a rewrite rule by invoking validation handlers and returning the validation result.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a rewrite rule by its ID and loads its details.

methods.name: NewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new rewrite rule with specified source and optional data, initializing via handlers.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all rewrite rules, sorted and loaded.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing rewrite rule with new data, invoking updating handlers.

methods.name: SaveAsync
methods.description: Saves a rewrite rule, invoking saving handlers.

methods.name: ResortOrderAsync
methods.description: Changes the order of rewrite rules based on old and new positions.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Loads a rewrite rule by invoking the loaded handler.

methods.name: GetSortedRuleAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all rules sorted by order and creation date.

methods.name: GetNextOrderSequence
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for a new rule, considering existing rules.
